title: Architecture Profile
description: The deterministically determined execution shape of a workspace member or segment (FR-013, FR-014). Embedded in the repository manifest and, when it differs, in the segment. Applicability-based remapping reads this: a weakness class is only ruled out when no reachable component can exhibit it, so an 'undetermined' shape disables suppression for that scope rather than defaulting to a guess (FR-013a, FR-013b).

scope.description: segment scope overrides member scope for findings located inside that segment

evidence.description: the manifest/config facts that determined the shape; required whenever shape is not 'undetermined', because a recorded shape always reflects positive evidence
